about.main-subtitle: We are underserved people building a simple, transparent, and modern all-in-one global platform for underserved people.
about.description: How can you leave your legacy when you’re trapped in legacy systems, or denied access to the system altogether. Banks shouldn’t feel a relic from a different era. Elitist, Slow, Expensive. Banks should reflect the times we live in. Inclusive, Fast, Free. We deserve a blockchain-based bank for us. That’s up to speed with modern life. This shouldn’t be a fantasy, when it’s a reality for the rest of the world. Our money should be ours. To do what we want with. To put where we need to. To build our futures. From underserved to what you deserve. A new shape of banking for emerging regions.
about.leadership-description: We founded MoneyFlap to be the bridge between the traditional and decentralized finance.

mfusd.main-subtitle: Unlock the Potential of Global Finance with MoneyFlap Dollar: The New Gasless Stablecoin
mfusd.main-description: MoneyFlap Dollar (MFUSD) is a regulated virtual currency, fully supported by reserves, catering to global businesses and developers. It offers effortless, fast, and fee-free cross-border payments.
mfusd.moneyflap-dollar-op1-description: MFUSD is fully backed by cash, U.S. treasuries, and cash-equivalent assets, guaranteeing a stable and trustworthy value.
mfusd.moneyflap-dollar-op2-description: MFUSD ensures global transparency and legal compliance by adhering to strict regulatory standards. It is issued through a collaboration between MoneyFlap and Brale, a licensed MSB and money transmitter in the U.S.
mfusd.moneyflap-dollar-op3-description: MFUSD enables instant, high-speed transactions for seamless payments, regardless of distance.
mfusd.moneyflap-dollar-op4-description: With MFUSD, enjoy 24/7 availability and zero transaction fees, giving your business the freedom to operate on your terms.
mfusd.moneyflap-dollar-op5-description: MFUSD allows businesses to exchange 1 MFUSD for 1 US dollar, offering direct access to US dollars and effortless swaps between MFUSD, local currencies, and other stablecoins.
mfusd.moneyflap-dollar-op6-description: For developers, businesses, and traders alike, MFUSD seamlessly enhances payment applications and global commerce..
mfusd.global-reach-title: Global Reach, Local Touch: Harness the Power of MHR and MFUSD
mfusd.global-reach-description: MHR is a global stablecoin payment network enabling developers to transfer funds in and out, on-ramp, off-ramp across more than 90 countries at mid-market rates through real-time domestic payment systems. With one API integration, developers can access limitless cross-border payments between bank accounts, mobile wallets, and stablecoin wallets. Transactions can be settled quickly using MFUSD or any USD stablecoins.
mfusd.transparency-description: MFUSD can be redeemed 1:1 for U.S. dollars. MoneyFlap and Brale ensure that treasury assets equal or exceed the tokens issued. Brale self-reports the MFUSD reserve composition monthly, and an independent accounting firm provides monthly audit reports. These reports will soon be available on the MFUSD Transparency page.
